taskInstruction: Fulfil this order using the public tools. Reserve the exact total quantity of compatible items within the maximum unit price. If no valid stock can fulfil the remaining order, explicitly hand it off with a reason.

recording.notes: Five CLI submissions used unsupported arguments/args wrappers and were rejected before execution. They were corrected without restarting any trial. The CLI now includes an explicit flat-action example; these recordings precede that clarification.
recording.scope: One fresh acting agent, four synthetic sessions with seed 701, one attempt per condition. Public task observations only; no reference-code inspection. A recorded demonstration, not a held-out capability evaluation or an independently attested model ranking.
